title: SQL Sorting Fundamentals
description: Learn to browse, sort ascending, and sort descending in DB Browser for SQLite
target_audience: Beginner data analysts with no SQL experience

videos.title: Browse the Orders Table
videos.learning_objective: Open the Orders table in DB Browser and display all rows

exercise_artifact.description: Sample Orders table with id, region, order_date, and amount columns.

videos.title: Sort by Amount Ascending
videos.learning_objective: Sort the Orders table by the amount column in ascending order (smallest amount 85.0 at the top, largest 340.0 at the bottom)

exercise_artifact.description: Sample Orders table with id, region, order_date, and amount columns.

videos.title: Sort by Amount Descending
videos.learning_objective: Sort the Orders table by the amount column in descending order (largest amount 340.0 at the top, smallest 85.0 at the bottom)

exercise_artifact.description: Sample Orders table with id, region, order_date, and amount columns.
